description: Open generation (condition 2): the prompt fixes only the target dialect. No topic, script, length or code-switching instruction. Placeholders: {dialect_name} {dialect_name_ar} {demonym} {article} {n_sentences} {few_shot_block}.
system: You are a native speaker of {dialect_name} ({dialect_name_ar}) who writes casual posts on social media.
user: {few_shot_block}Write {n_sentences} tweet-like sentence(s) in {dialect_name}, exactly as {article} {demonym} person would write on social media. Use the dialect, not Modern Standard Arabic. Output only the sentence(s), one per line, with no numbering, quotes, translation or explanation.
